newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete says with Mitsubishi in Mexico refinery bid.
newsitem.headline: Bufete says with Mitsubishi in Mexico refinery bid.

text.p: Mexican construction company Bufete Industrial said on Tuesday it joined with Mitsubishi, Mitsui and Itochu in a consortium to bid for an expansion project at Mexico's Cadereyta refinery.
"The (consortium) group will contract Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd, JGC Corp and Bufete for the engineering, procurement and construction of the project," Bufete said in a statement.

At least 10 different companies have begun lining up for the Cadereyta refining project outside the city of Monterrey in the northern state of Nuevo Leon. An investment of $1.2 billion is expected for a three-year concession to build nine new units and expand five existing sites.
Bufete's executive vice president of business development called the project "one of the largest complexes ever developed by Pemex Refining."
"Bufete's participation includes a portion of the basic engineering, all of the detailed engineering, the domestic procurement and the overall construction of the complex," the company said.
The winner for the project is expected to be announced by late August.
